items.title: Hackers Are Turning Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot Into Bait for Real Malware
items.description: Cybercriminals are increasingly using trusted artificial intelligence names as a shortcut to infect users with malware. Fake download pages, browser extensions, search ads and shared AI conversations are being used to make harmful files and commands look legitimate. The campaigns target people looking for popular AI tools, coding assistants and productivity features. A victim may […] The post…

items.title: ToxicPanda 2.0 and GoldDigger Expand Android Banking Attacks with On-Device Fraud
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on an updated version of ToxicPanda (aka TgToxic) that comes with "significant enhancements," including a set of 167 remote commands and expands its targeting footprint globally. Zimperium zLabs, in a Wednesday report, said the Android malware also features a PIN harvesting workflow targeting more than 140 banking and cryptocurrency applications.

items.description: Security researchers have demonstrated that an expired credit card is not as dead as most cardholders believe. items.description: Firefox users are facing a coordinated campaign of malicious add-ons that masquerade as cryptocurrency wallets, themes, and simple browser tools.
